a: 史实：爱迪生名下共 1,093 项美国专利，多由门洛帕克实验室团队研发（US Patent Office）。
史实：1882 年爱迪生在曼哈顿建成珍珠街直流发电站，率先点亮纽约 400 盏灯。
史实：1897 年特斯拉为帮威斯汀豪斯渡过危机，亲手撕毁价值数千万美元的交流电专利抽成合同。
史实：1943 年特斯拉在纽约客酒店 3327 房贫困离世，晚年每天去公园喂白鸽。
b: 辟谣：爱迪生之前已有 22 人造出白炽灯（如斯旺），爱迪生是买下专利并改良竹丝商业化。
史实：1885 年爱迪生承诺给特斯拉 5 万美元改良直流电机，事后赖账称「你不懂美式幽默」。
物理：110V 直流电传输超 1.6 公里即严重损耗，特斯拉多相交流电最终统治全球电网。
致敬：1960 年国际磁感应单位定名「特斯拉(T)」，2003 年马斯克以他之名创立 Tesla 电动车。

actions.A1: fierce and cocky, tapping the gold pocket-watch chain on his vest, then holding up the warm glowing amber bulb beside his grinning face
actions.A2: sweeping his glowing amber light bulb wide toward the cheering crowd while looking down at Tesla
actions.A3: rubbing his thumb and fingers together in a money gesture, laughing mockingly into the microphone
actions.A4: flapping his free hand mockingly like a pigeon wing, then pointing sharply at Tesla on the last word
actions.B1: holding up two fingers twice to show twenty-two, then thrusting his crackling blue-violet Tesla coil right toward Edison's dim yellow bulb
actions.B2: mimicking a handshake in mid-air and slicing his hand sideways as blue electric sparks flash from his brass coil
actions.B3: flicking Edison's warm yellow bulb with one finger as his own blue-violet Tesla coil blazes brighter across both faces
actions.B4: raising the crackling blue-violet Tesla coil high above his head as lightning arcs behind him, triumphant and fierce
actions.B_REACT: holding the brass Tesla coil as small blue-violet sparks dance across the toroid, watching Edison with a cold knowing smirk
actions.A_REACT: clenching his jaw as his warm yellow bulb flickers in his hand, forcing a tight furious smile
